business_problem: Capillary Technologies needed to process and analyze massive loyalty and marketing datasets in time to deliver real-time personalized campaigns, but its legacy data warehouse was slowing performance and increasing infrastructure and maintenance costs.
solution_summary: Capillary rebuilt its personalization stack on the Databricks Data + AI Platform using a lakehouse architecture instead of its overloaded legacy data warehouse. Loyalty, transaction, and registration data from more than 400 brands flow into a unified environment that combines lake-scale storage with warehouse performance, letting the team process more than 13 billion transaction records per year without prior infrastructure drag. Capillary uses high-performance data pipelines and managed clusters on Databricks to prepare analytics for campaign execution, while MLflow simplifies the model lifecycle for targeting and retention models. Databricks SQL gives internal users visual access to results, and Delta Lake provides the shared storage foundation for analytics and machine learning. By removing manual infrastructure and MLOps work, the implementation lets Capillary launch personalized campaigns faster, improve retention, and control resource usage as client onboarding grows.

solution_components.name: Databricks Data + AI Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the lakehouse environment where Capillary processes loyalty data and runs analytics and machine learning workloads for campaign personalization.

solution_components.name: Delta Lake
solution_components.role: Acts as the shared lakehouse storage layer for large client datasets used by analytics and machine learning pipelines.

solution_components.name: Databricks SQL
solution_components.role: Delivers query access and visual insight consumption for internal business users working with campaign and customer-performance data.

solution_components.name: MLflow
solution_components.role: Supports the machine learning workflow so new targeting and retention models can move to production faster.

data_flow: Loyalty, transaction, and registration data from Capillary's client programs land in the Databricks lakehouse, pipelines and managed clusters prepare them for analytics and machine learning, MLflow helps operationalize models, and Databricks SQL exposes insights for teams running and optimizing personalized campaigns.
business_outcome: Capillary increased marketing campaign conversion rates by 600 percent, reduced compute and infrastructure costs by 35 percent, cut inference queries from 150 seconds to 115 seconds, saved 180 hours of MLOps overhead, and got new models into production faster to improve retention performance.
architecture_clues: Capillary adopted a lakehouse architecture to unify data, analytics, and machine learning workloads.
Managed cluster and infrastructure operations removed back-end heavy lifting from the data team.
High-performance data pipelines feed analytics and machine learning use cases for personalized campaigns.
Databricks visualizations help internal business consumers make decisions from campaign data.
evidence_quotes: With over 13 billion customer records to analyze, Capillary’s legacy infrastructure buckled under the weight of their clients’ data sets — slowing performance and creating operational overhead.

With over 100 global loyalty programs in flight at any given time, Capillary processes more than 13 billion transaction records per year while recording 187 million new customer registrations during the same time period.
With Databricks Data + AI Platform, they are able to streamline cluster management and build highly performant and reliable data pipelines to feed their analytics and machine learning needs.
With MLflow, we have been able to build an ML workflow with ease, saving us 180 hours of MLOps overhead.

From an operations perspective, the automation and sheer performance of the lakehouse allowed them to reduce inference queries from 150 seconds to 115 seconds — reducing customer resource usage and costs by 35%.
Using Capillary’s algorithm on Databricks Data + AI Platform, the conversion rate of the campaign increased by 600%.
